summary: Apple began testing Apple Intelligence in mainland China on November 4 Beijing time with the iOS 27.3 developer beta. Developers with compatible iPhones can enable the features after installing the update, bringing Apple’s system-level AI tools to the market ahead of a planned public release in Dece
